audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart showed Skill at Levels 3 and 4-5 and Dr. Mundo from Level 6 on, while the prose (whys[3..5], mid) says Kled beats you through first item, and the packet chart gives Kled every stage until 2+ items. Win rate is 46.53% over 591 games.
audit.why: Kled's Violent Tendencies (W) four-attack burst plus Skaarl's courage remount out-damages Mundo's regen until Mundo has two HP items; the chart contradicted both the packet and its own explanatory text.
audit.corrected: Kled wins Level 1 through First item; Dr. Mundo takes 2+ items. Ratings 3/4/4/4/5/5/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] used the fabricated ult name 'Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!!' and never mentioned the shield.
audit.why: Riot's name is Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and the ability grants a shield on the charge (kit flag: shield), which absorbs the burst window Mundo needs.
audit.corrected: Name the ult correctly and state that its shield eats your commit, so bait it before you spend E + R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names wrong throughout: 'Beartrap on a Rope' (real: Bear Trap on a Rope), 'Blunt Force (E)' (real: Blunt Force Trauma), and Mundo's healing attributed to Q Infected Bonesaw instead of W Heart Zapper. No cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Heart Zapper (W) is the ability that stores damage and heals; Infected Bonesaw (Q) only slows and deals current-health damage. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s, Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9s, Jousting 13/12/11/10/9s, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140/125/110s.
audit.corrected: Use the real names, credit the heal to Heart Zapper, and key step-ups to Bear Trap's 11s rank-1 cooldown. Kled's opener is a Violent Tendencies auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell.

audit.why: 46.53% over 591 games matches the losing-lane framing once the chart is fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The suspectNames flag on wants.foe[1] 'Use Violent Tendencies' is a false positive.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is Kled's real W name in Riot's data.

edits.before: Kled bullies you the whole early game — his Q Bear Trap on a Rope pulls and his passive Skaarl remount plus Violent Tendencies attack speed shred your health faster than Q Infected Bonesaw can heal it back.
edits.after: Kled bullies the whole early game — Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) is a 11s cooldown at rank 1, and Skaarl's courage remount plus Violent Tendencies (W) attack speed shred you faster than Heart Zapper (W) heals.

edits.before: His R Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!! is a global engage and his dismount all-in can burst you; even with R Maximum Dosage you struggle because his sustained DPS and remount out-trade your regen.
edits.after: His R is Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and the charge grants a shield that eats your burst window — bait it before you commit. Maximum Dosage regen still loses to his remount plus Violent Tendencies DPS.

edits.before: Kled's early-item bruiser spike keeps him ahead; his Violent Tendencies auto-resets tear through your armor and he simply out-DPS's your healing in extended fights.
edits.after: Kled's early-item spike keeps him ahead; Violent Tendencies (W) is an auto-attack reset on a 9s cooldown at rank 5 — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Kled's level 1 Violent Tendencies and Q pull out-trade your early sustain.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies (W) gives four fast attacks — level 1 he out-trades you flat.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his sustained DPS out-paces your Q Infected Bonesaw healing.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his sustained DPS out-paces Heart Zapper's stored-damage heal.

edits.before: Kled owns levels 1-2: his Q Bear Trap on a Rope pull sets up an all-in and his Violent Tendencies attack speed with the Skaarl remount out-trades your Q Infected Bonesaw sustain, so play safe, dodge the trap, and don't get pulled into a bad fight.
edits.after: Kled owns levels 1-2: Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) yanks you in on an 11s cooldown, and Violent Tendencies (W) plus the Skaarl remount out-trades Heart Zapper's heal — dodge sideways behind a minion and step up only in that 11s gap.

edits.before: It stays his lane through 6 — his R Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!! engage and dismount burst threaten to kill you even under R Maximum Dosage, because his sustained DPS and remount health beat your regen; farm carefully and give up the losing trades.
edits.after: It stays his lane through 6 — Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) engages with a shield that absorbs your burst, and his remount health beats Maximum Dosage regen; farm, force the shield out on minions, and give up the losing trades entirely.

edits.after: Dismount him and run him down. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 — commit only inside that downtime.

edits.before: Kled wins by landing Beartrap on a Rope, denying your sustain windows, and out-trading your engage.
edits.after: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap on a Rope, remounting Skaarl off your minions, and shielding through your all-in.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Beartrap on a Rope is up.
edits.after: Your passive eats the first Bear Trap, but the canister must be walked over to pay off. Poke with Infected Bonesaw and never brawl while Violent Tendencies is up.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Kled to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage helps, but Chaaaaaaaarge!!! brings a shield and a 140s cooldown he will spend on you. Survive the charge, then punish the ult downtime, not the fight.

edits.before: Chase his W remount blindly — that is the exchange Kled wins flat.
edits.after: Fight a full-courage Skaarl — remounted, he wins that exchange flat.

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 — step up only in that downtime.

edits.before: Fighting on his terms lets him stack his strengths and flip the trade.
edits.after: Never brawl while Violent Tendencies is up — four fast attacks beat you.

edits.before: Kled is fragile dismounted. Trade to strip his courage, dodge his Q pull, and out-sustain him; chase him down on foot with R. Track Beartrap on a Rope before every step-up.
edits.after: Kled is fragile dismounted. Strip Skaarl's health, dodge Bear Trap on a Rope, then chase the foot form with Maximum Dosage move speed. Deny him minion kills or he remounts.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope (7s): matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope (11s at rank 1, 7s at rank 5): his engage hook — dodge it and commit in the gap. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (140s at rank 1): shields him, so bait it first. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call.

notes: Level chart flipped to match packet and the existing prose: Kled wins Level 1 through First item, Mundo takes 2+ items. suspectNames flagged 'Use Violent Tendencies' in wants.foe[1] — false positive, that is Kled's real W name; left alone. Real errors killed: 'Beartrap on a Rope' -> Bear Trap on a Rope, 'Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!!' -> Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and the heal credited to Q Infected Bonesaw when it is W Heart Zapper. Did not assert whether Mundo's passive CC-resist consumes Bear Trap's shackle before or after the yank (unverified).
